tool_input.title: Fix rounding in invoice totals
tool_input.head: fix-rounding
tool_input.body: Invoice totals were rounded half-up while the bank export rounds half-even, so about 1 in 200 invoices differed by a cent from the bank's figure. This switches parse_amount and the total calculation to half-even, adds tests for the cases that differed, and regenerates the fixtures in tests/data. Invoices already issued are not recalculated; a follow-up can decide whether to reissue the 14 affected invoices from March. No schema changes, no new dependencies.
